```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Initialize the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a count plot for transaction types with hue based on fraud
sns.countplot(data=data, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', palette='Set2')

# Add axis labels and title
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Count', fontsize=14)
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Types with Fraud Indication', fontsize=16)

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
